comment: MPEG-2 transport packet header: sync byte, transport error, payload unit start (PUSI:
a section or PES packet starts in this payload, after a pointer field for sections), priority, PID, scrambling,
adaptation field control (1 payload only, 2 adaptation field only, 3 both) and the continuity counter, then the
adaptation field when there is one (its length, its bytes). The payload runs to the packet's end:
the frame length a profile gives (188 bytes, from the step that cut the packets)
